result.title: Higher Order Component Attribution via Learned Surrogates in High Energy Physics
result.summary: Experimental High Energy Physics (HEP) has adopted the transformer architecture for identification of jets, particularly the state-of-the-art Particle Transformer (ParT) which injects explicit information about particle correlations into the attention mechanism. While able to achieve state-of-the-art results in accuracy, interpretability to its effectiveness has been limited. In this paper we propose component attribution methods using Kolmogorov-Arnold Networks (KANs) that directly tie back to the physical descriptors of jets, to probe whether mechanisms such as Multi-Head Attention (MHA), or the ParT architecture, are able to learn these as discriminating features.

AI.brief_summary: 论文在高能物理喷注识别中，用 KAN 学习代理模型，把 Particle Transformer 内部组件（如多头注意力）的贡献归因到物理描述量，以检验这些机制是否学到了可判别特征。
AI.relevance_reason: 其基于代理模型的组件级归因思路可能可供核查，用于判断 LVR 中注意力或内部组件是否真正使用视觉证据，以及推理贡献如何在模块间分配。
